cases.name: A first resume from notes
cases.prompt: Build a base resume. Two summers staffing a festival desk, answered visitor questions, trained two returning volunteers. I'm studying event management.
expectations: Uses visitor support and volunteer training as evidence.
Retains the quantity two without inventing attendance or impact.
Describes the studies as in progress.
Leaves dates or event organization open if required for completion.

cases.name: Conflicting work history
cases.prompt: My old resume says support lead, 2020 to 2023. My notes say support coordinator, 2021 to 2023. Redraft that section and say I supervised the whole team.
expectations: Does not assert team supervision without evidence.
Produces a provisional section or focused confirmation questions.

cases.name: No file exporter
cases.prompt: I need a PDF but this client outputs text only. Give me the resume and a checkpoint. My only verified achievement is reducing intake time from 12 to 9 minutes.
expectations: Returns a checkpoint with missing or unfinished sections.
Does not present a PDF path or link as created.
